title: The Art of Aging in Dentistry
subtitle: Dr. Ahmed & Dr. Sofia are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 👨‍⚕️👩‍⚕️

Dr. Ahmed is an experienced dentist. After 30 years of practice, he feels the first signs of age: fatigue, back pain, declining concentration. He wonders if he is still capable of practicing as before.

Dr. Sofia, his colleague and friend, opens his eyes: 'Ahmed, you don't have to stop. You can adapt your activity, prepare your succession, pass on your knowledge.'

But what happens if the succession is not prepared? What becomes of the patients, the practice, the family?

The health of seniors, the transmission of knowledge, and the future of dental practices rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Ahmed, a senior dentist, feels the first signs of fatigue and pain. He consults Dr. Sofia to find solutions. Discover how to manage professional aging with wisdom and serenity.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Ahmed has died suddenly. His family (Nadia, Karim, Salma) is distraught. Dr. Sofia accompanies them through the procedures: securing the practice, evaluation, succession, transmission. A painful but necessary transition.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Ahmed, before passing away, had begun a reflection on his future. Dr. Sofia helps him adapt his practice, manage his health, and prepare his succession. The wisdom of the senior is a strength.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Ahmed and Dr. Sofia deepen the preparation of the transmission: legal aspects, practice evaluation, choice of successor, training of the successor. A successful transmission is a prepared one.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Ahmed becomes a mentor for young dentists. He passes on his experience, clinical wisdom, and values. The senior becomes a pillar of the profession.
chapters.expert2: After a fulfilling career, Dr. Ahmed bows out. He leaves a legacy of skills, values, and humanity. The memory of seniors is the memory of the profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Ahmed became aware of the signs of aging. He knows he must act.
chapterEndings.debutant2: Ahmed's family understood the importance of preparation. A painful lesson.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Managing aging is mastered. Ahmed feels more serene.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: The preparation of the succession is underway. Ahmed has found a successor.
chapterEndings.expert1: Ahmed has become a mentor. His experience is a wealth for the profession.
chapterEndings.expert2: Ahmed has accomplished his mission. The memory of seniors is the memory of the profession.
